summary: The registrant Ridgepost Capital, Inc. filed a Form 8-K covering quarterly results, an investor presentation, and a declared $0.04/share cash dividend payable June 18, 2026. The filing also discloses $6 million in stock repurchases during Q1 at an average $8.55 per share. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is reported. The dividend and ordinary buyback constitute routine capital allocation, not a special-situation capital return. Therefore, this filing does not qualify for any special-situations category.
